Protests in Pakistan-occupied Kashmir prompt calls for India's help

Protests have intensified in Pakistan-occupied Kashmir (PoK) over alleged brutalities and blockades, with residents appealing to India for assistance. Amidst the unrest, India has reportedly tightened its vigil along the Line of Control. The situation has also seen Pakistan urging all parties to uphold commitments under the Islamabad MoU, while regional tensions in West Asia have led India to call for restraint.
